items.title: fix(static): serveStatic generates invalid double-slash root index path (//index.html) and concatenates subfolder paths without slash when relative indexNames are used
fix(response): keep `iterable` streaming past skipped values
items.body:
`iterable()` drops `undefined` values and values the serializer returns `undefined` for, but the `pull()` call that drops one resolves without enqueuing anything. `ReadableStream` only calls `pull()` again if another read arrived while it was running, so a pending read can be left unanswered and the response never finishes. Consecutive or trailing skips can trigger it on both web and node:

```ts
iterable(["a", undefined, "b", undefined]); // hangs, expected "ab"
iterable(["a", "skip", "skip", "b"], { serializer }); // serializer returns undefined for "skip"; hangs, expected "ab"
```

`pull()` now keeps reading until it enqueues a chunk or the iterator is done. Values that serialize to a chunk are handled as before.

- Ran: `pnpm vitest run test/iterable.test.ts`: both new tests time out on `main` in web and node (4 failed, 38 passed) and pass with the fix (42 passed).
- Ran: `pnpm vitest run --coverage`: 73 files, 3134 passed, 51 skipped.
- Checked: `pnpm typecheck`, `oxlint .` and `pnpm build` pass; `oxfmt --check` is clean on the changed files.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Response streams continue past values that produce no output, allowing later values to be delivered.
  * Values that cannot be serialized are omitted without interrupting the remaining stream.
  * Streams close when iteration finishes, including when the final value has no serializable output.
  * After cancellation, streams stop reading additional values and do not serialize values that arrive afterward.

items.title: fix(cache): honor request methods when evaluating cache headers
items.body:
resolves #1623

Matching `If-None-Match` preconditions stop POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE with `412` rather than `304` ([RFC 9110 §13.1.2](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-13.1.2)). These methods ignore `If-Modified-Since`; OPTIONS, TRACE, and CONNECT ignore conditional headers ([§13.2.1](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110#section-13.2.1)). GET, HEAD, and QUERY retain their existing `304` behavior.

The issue includes a runnable reproduction. Regression tests cover both web and Node adapters, including weak tags, wildcards, nonmatches, and validator overrides; helper-level tests also cover TRACE and CONNECT. They fail with only the source changes reverted.

`pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, and the affected suites passed. Local `pnpm test`: 3,219 passed, 51 skipped, one Node body-limit timeout; unchanged main at f0e1780: 3,128 passed, 51 skipped, two body-limit timeouts, including the same test.


<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

<!-- coderabbit-ai-generated:v1 -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Conditional cache validation now returns `304 Not Modified` for matching validators on `GET`, `HEAD`, and `QUERY` requests.
  * For other methods, a matching `If-None-Match` returns `412 Precondition Failed`; `If-Modified-Since` does not trigger a conditional response.
  * `CONNECT`, `OPTIONS`, and `TRACE` requests ignore both conditional headers and continue processing.

* **Documentation**
  * Clarified how conditional cache headers are handled across request methods.
